title: Door decisions read by the paired Business
description: Wire agreement for BASE-AGENT-014 (the paired Business reads every door decision) and BASE-AGENT-015 (links from Business open the seed's own pages). The root is the 200 body of GET <appOrigin>/api/rer/agent-decisions. modules/agent-door/ADOPTING.md, 'Business decision reads and record links', is the normative text.

page.description: One read. Decisions are in cursor order. Fewer than the requested limit means the reader has caught up.

cursor.description: Position after the last decision returned, or the request's own position when none was returned. Opaque to Business: store it and send it back as `after`.

decision.description: The public projection of one audited door call. Nothing else leaves the audit.

id.description: The seed's audit row id. Stable across retries and re-reads; a later change of the same call arrives under the same id.

tool.description: The registry tool name, or resources/read. Null only when the call named no tool this seed registers (code tool_not_found).

decision.description: As the seed recorded it; none when the call was refused before the policy decided.

outcome.description: May change later under the same id.

code.description: For a refused call: the refusal code when the seed documents it (Base's shared door codes, or a code the seed declares for /docs/agents), otherwise refused. Null for every other outcome.

revision.description: The policy revision the call was decided under, or null. Never filled in from Business's current revision.

consent.description: The consent id of the access token the paired Business issued for the call; null for embedded agents and the seed's own credentials.

refusal.description: Body of every non-200 answer from the decision read: 401 unauthenticated (one body for every refused credential), 404 not_found (the installation holds no owner-claim trust), 400 invalid_request, 405 method_not_allowed.

credentialHeader.description: Protected header of the read credential, a compact ES256 JWS sent only as Authorization: Bearer.

kid.description: A key id in the installation's owner-claim public-key ring.

credentialClaims.description: Claims of the read credential. exp - iat is at most 300 seconds; iat may lead the installation's clock by at most 30 seconds.

iss.description: The owner-claim issuer the installation trusts.

aud.description: The installation's application origin, as in its owner-claim trust.

business.description: The Business id. Equals the business of the policy envelope the installation adopted under this trust.

recordLink.description: BASE-AGENT-015 link to a declared record resource: the installation's application origin, the Base destination /app/open, and exactly one resource parameter holding the percent-encoded resource URI (encodeURIComponent).

auditLink.description: BASE-AGENT-015 link to an audit row: the installation's application origin, /app/open and exactly one audit parameter holding a decision id.
